steps.name: Richele
steps.text: The paperwork's done.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Good work, rookie.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Just doing my job. How's the old man doing?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: There's nothing more the doctors can do for him.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Which is to say...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: What's our job now? Executing the citizen's will in our capacity as executors?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Of course. It's our most important duty.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Speaking of wills... Richele! Attention!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: That's more like it. Look alive when you're working!

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: I know it's your first mission and I don't want to put unnecessary pressure on you. However...

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: This is a secret mission, Richele.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: A secret mission?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Yes. Take this.
The veteran executor takes out a sealed envelope, then tears a page out of her notebook and writes an address on it.
Then she solemnly gives the envelope and the note to the rookie.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Time is of the essence. Deliver this document to this address today. You'll need to leave immediately.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: There will be someone there to receive it.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: I can't tell you. Discretion is crucial for an executor.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: But I can tell you that this is an important mission. The contents of the document could throw all of Laterano into chaos.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Throw all of Laterano into chaos...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Seriously?)

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: But I'm new on the job. Is this really a task I should be entrusted with?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Isn't it more suited to a veteran, like you...?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Unfortunately, I have other urgent matters to attend to. You're the only one I can count on.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: You passed the Notarial Hall's entrance exam. You've proven your mettle. Now it's time to show it.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Is this how promotion exams work in the Notarial Hall?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Promotion exam?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Er, well, yes! Complete this mission, and you'll be a proper Executor!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I guess I'll set out now, if you put it that way.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Take care!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I will... try...

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Good luck, rookie.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (This address is in the outskirts.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (The fastest way would be to go straight down this street and just keep going.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Before that, though...)

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: Did you know? There's a new shop in Pagus Stevonus. They say it sells the best donuts in town!

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: I got in line in the morning and bought two. Try it out!

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: Ah, I've tried it before. It's not bad, but...

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: But what? Are you going to keep me guessing?

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: Old Darian's donuts are the best. Even better than the new shop.

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: I tried it once, and I could never forget it.

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: Really? I don't believe you.

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: Hey, man, try this donut! I guarantee it's the best you've ever had.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Who? Me?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sorry, I'm in a hurry. Ask someone else.

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: Hey! Wait up!

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: It won't take long...
The executor-in-training's hand moves instinctively, but he drops it back down.
Richele face twitches a little.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sorry, I really am in a hurry.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: Wait...!

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: (Damn, he's fast!)

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: (After him! Don't let him get away!)

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: *pant*...*pant*....

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: I... I'm out of breath... where did he go?

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: No idea... he can run...

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: I told you that wouldn't work... getting close to him while pretending to chat like that...

steps.name: Chatting Passerby
steps.text: We should have stopped him and taken it by force!

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: Now's not the time for that! I... I've notified the others.

steps.name: Laid-Back Passerby
steps.text: After him!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: So they were after me...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Or, to be more specific, what I'm carrying.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: The only thing I can think of is this confidential document.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I expected something, but not so soon... how did they know who I was and where I was?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: It sounds like there are others...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (...! Who is it this time?)

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member
steps.text: Excuse me, Senior.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member
steps.text: Someone just reported a robbery around here.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member
steps.text: Did you see anyone suspicious?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: No idea, I'm just passing by.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Is it a coincidence that he's standing in my way?)

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member
steps.text: As the only potential witness right now, I must ask you to cooperate...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sorry, I'm in a hurry!

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Cleric
steps.text: Excuse me!

steps.name: Cleric
steps.text: Is something troubling you? Is there anything I can help you with?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Another one.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Well... the situation right now is kind of troubling.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sorry, but I really have to be going.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member?
steps.text: Hold it right there!

steps.name: Cleric?
steps.text: We can't let you go.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Er... what do you mean?

steps.name: Cleric?
steps.text: No need to play dumb. You know what we're after.

steps.name: Cleric?
steps.text: Hand it over!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Well, well, well... what do we have here?)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (On the other hand, I don't sense any real hostility in their expression. What is going on with this mission?)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Well, it's my first ever job...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I can't screw it up.

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member?
steps.text: Do we do it?

steps.name: Pontifica Cohors Member?
steps.text: Let's see what a Notarial Hall Executor's gun is like.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Could we avoid causing so much commotion in the middle of town?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Bare hands will do.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: I've reviewed your Pontifica Cohors record.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: You've proven to be an outstanding soldier.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Gratias.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Are you satisfied with being just that?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: You've done your job well, but one soldier more or less makes no difference to Laterano.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: We didn't bring you back from that Siracusan town because we wanted a soldier.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: What do you think of Laterano?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: It... it's a fine place.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Much better than I expected, in fact. Not just the prosperity... but also a certain order that permeates everyone's lives.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Our Commandments?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I guess.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Sometimes people want to blow up decorations on the streets, and people like to watch it, but that's not such a bad thing.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: What I mean is...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Not the kind of bad thing where people get hurt, people die, and even those who aren't hurt or dead see their lives destroyed.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I like this place.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Okay, now I should be fine.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (I can stuff someone into a trash bin, right? As long as they're alive, right? Yeah, I'm sure that's cool...)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Secret mission, robbers in the middle of the street... is that what life in Laterano is like?)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (First mission ever, and it's a hot mess...)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Maybe I could get a transfer back to the Pontifica Cohors.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Get the stuff to the destination, and then... hm?)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Another one.

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: S-Stop right there!

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: You shall not pass... er, well, just stop!

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Hand it over!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Hm?)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (No sign of professional training. Not what you would expect from someone trying to rob an executor.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Is this a disguise in itself? Something doesn't feel right...)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Pardon me, but what do you mean?

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: The envelope in your hands!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: This one? I'm afraid I can't assent to handing it over.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: It's my job, after all.

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Well, I can't back off either...

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: If you won't hand it over, then I'll have to take it by force!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Hey! Violence is bad!

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Argh... let go of me!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Your form was messy. Your footwork was poor, and the delivery was sloppy.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I thought self-defense was part of compulsory Lateran education. How did you graduate?

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: I passed the class! It's not like I'm working any dangerous jobs...

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Let me go!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Not working any dangerous jobs?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I would say trying to rob an executor is plenty dangerous.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: How about this: You tell me who sent you, and who else is involved, and I let you go?

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: I-I can't!

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: I can't tell you. You don't know what you're dealing with...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I heard it was something that could 'throw all Laterano into chaos.'

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Some sort of weapon blueprint?

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: You could say that...

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Anyway, I'm not talking! Don't even bother!

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: You're right. This is what sets Laterano apart from the rest.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: You said Laterano was special. What about yourself?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I'm Sankta... so I guess I'm Lateran?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: That's not enough.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Let's go to the Notarial Hall. I'll write you a letter of recommendation.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Be more than a spectator. Experience the life of a true Lateran yourself.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: The life of a true Lateran...

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: I think you'll like it.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I've already been delayed too long.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Things would be much easier if we weren't in Laterano... I'm not sure I like all this complicated stuff.

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Wh-What do you mean?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: What I mean is...
The trainee executor draws the gun from his waist and regretfully presses it against the youth's forehead.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: It's such a beautiful day. I didn't want to have to do this.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Hello, this is the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: The commission? Our executor is on it. It will be done today.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: ...Complications?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Understood. I will deal with it immediately.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: No worries. Richele may be a rookie, and he has much to learn, but...

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: I trust him. He'll complete the mission.

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: ...I, I'm alive?

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Whoa! It's gonna fall!

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: H-He shot through the pillar? That's crazy...

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: He almost broke my arm...

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Hey, it's me.

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Sorry, I couldn't stop him.

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: I told you, how was I supposed to stop an Executor?

steps.name: Nervous Youth
steps.text: Well, I think we worked hard enough to make Old Darian happy.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Whew, almost didn't hold back...)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (This is Laterano. I have to do things the Lateran way.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Phew...)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (Almost there.)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Salve.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: (There's no one else here. There's no mistake, right?)

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Are you the recipient of this will?

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Yes, I am.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Thank you for delivering it.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Just doing my job.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: This is the envelope I was asked to deliver.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Are you not curious what's inside?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I heard it's important.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Yes, yes. Very important and precious...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Is it really something I should know?

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: The value of something doesn't lie in the number of people who know it or possess it.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: I'll read it out once everyone is here.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You're reading it in public?!

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Go ahead, open it.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: One egg, three tablespoons of sugar, yeast...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: One cup of flour, two tablespoons of maple syrup...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: A donut recipe?

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Yes. A nice one, isn't it?

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: This is what my husband gave me when he proposed to me.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: My family and friends chased him all the way. You should have seen him when he finally made it to me.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Your husband was the decedent?

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: We didn't have any children. Not that it was ever a problem. We were happy together, the two of us.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: But we didn't want the recipe to be lost once we're gone from Laterano.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Was there a need to hide it from the executor too, though?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: So, those people who tried to stop me were all part of the plan?

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Consider it an old man's last little game.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: I'm sure he thought I didn't know and wanted to give me a surprise, so that the recipe could be passed on to the next generation over the sound of cheering...

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: Here, have a donut.

steps.name: Elegant Old Lady
steps.text: I'm sure you'll like it.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: How was it?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Sorry I couldn't tell you the truth. That was part of the client's will.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I still don't understand...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Why do Laterans do this sort of thing, even though it's completely unnecessary?

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: You said you liked sweet stuff, just like pretty much everyone else in Laterano.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: The old man overheard you saying it, which was why he asked for you to deliver the recipe.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: It would be even better if you learned it and made those donuts regularly.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: That's how Laterans are. And you can expect more of this, if you stay on the job.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Not happy about it?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: On the contrary...

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I love it.

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Excellent!

steps.name: Notarial Hall Official
steps.text: Congratulations on a job well done, rookie!
